combo_label: Motorways & Service Stations × The Allotment × The Hobbit

entries.clue: Shell-less garden mollusc lured to a beery death in a sunken dish
Reflective studs down the middle of a road, Percy Shaw's 1934 invention
Preston's 1958 relief road, Britain's first motorway stretch, now part of the M6
Oakenshield who led the quest and died of wounds after the great battle
Overhead steel frame straddling the carriageway, hung with variable speed panels
Skin-changer who housed the travellers and fought the last battle as a bear
Spring-loaded snippers for stems too woody for scissors
Uninvited plants that reclaim every bare inch the second you stop pulling
Spider's spun trap, cut apart to free the captives in the dark trees
Angular carved letter of the sort that hid a message on the old map
Numbered way off the motorway; also what glows green above a fire door
Dark crumbly stuff made by letting peelings and clippings rot down
